meta.heading: Plan details
meta.defaultHint: Leave vehicle types empty to make this plan eligible to be the default.

info.planName: Internal name shown in plan lists and to staff — not shown to end customers.
info.timezone: IANA zone (e.g. Europe/Athens) used to convert window times and weekdays to local wall-clock time.
info.graceMinutes: Subtracted from the stay's duration before billing. Stays shorter than this are free; longer stays are billed for duration minus grace.
info.incrementMinutes: After grace is subtracted, billable duration rounds up to the next multiple of this value — e.g. a 61-minute stay with a 15-minute increment bills as 75 minutes.
info.validFrom: Plan becomes eligible for quoting and booking from this date onward. Leave empty for no start limit.
info.validTo: Plan stops being eligible for quoting and booking after this date. Leave empty for no end limit.
info.vehicleTypesLabel: Limits this plan to the selected vehicle types. Leave empty to price every vehicle type — required for the plan to be eligible as default.
info.active: Inactive plans stay saved but can't be assigned to facilities or used for quotes.
info.defaultPlan: Applied automatically to any facility with no plan explicitly assigned. Only available when vehicle types is empty.

rateGrid.heading: Rate grid
rateGrid.hint: Every tier × window needs a price. Empty cells are flagged and rejected on save.

info.currency: Currency used for every price in this grid and in quotes for this plan.
info.tierWindowHeader: Each cell prices one tier during one window. A stay is billed at the tier covering its cumulative duration, using the window active when that charge starts.

caps.heading: Caps (optional)
caps.hint: Clamp totals. Stay = whole stay; rolling = per window bucket (1440 = daily).

info.windowMinutes: Size of the repeating bucket the cap resets on (1440 = once per calendar day). Only used when scope is Rolling window.
info.cap: Maximum amount charged within the cap's scope — once per stay, or once per rolling window bucket.
info.scope: Whole stay caps the total once across the entire booking. Rolling window re-applies the cap on each repeating bucket above, so long stays get capped multiple times.

tiers.heading: Tiers
tiers.hint: Cumulative-duration bands. Each tier starts where the previous ends; the last tier is open-ended.

info.fromMinutes: Set automatically to the previous tier's end — tiers chain contiguously with no gap or overlap.
info.toMinutes: Minute where this tier ends and the next one begins. The last tier is always open-ended.
info.unit: Per minute charges rate × minutes spent in this tier. Per block charges the block rate once per full or partial block. Flat charges the tier's rate once, however long the tier lasts.
info.blockMinutes: Length of one billing block for a per-block tier. Any partial block still costs a full block's rate.

windows.heading: Windows
windows.hint: Time-of-day slots per weekday. Start is inclusive, end exclusive; end ≤ start wraps past midnight.
windows.label: Label
windows.uncoveredWarning: These days are not cleanly tiled across 24h (gap or overlap): {days}. Windows must run end-to-end from 00:00 to 24:00 with no gap or overlap. Pricing will be rejected until fixed.

info.label: Name shown as this window's column header in the rate grid below.
info.days: Weekdays this window applies to. Selected days must be fully covered by windows with no gap or overlap across 24 hours.
info.end: Local time this window ends (exclusive). Set it earlier than start to wrap past midnight.

list.title: Operator plans
list.description: Subscription plans operators can be placed on, with the capacity and features each one grants.

empty.title: No operator plans yet
empty.default: Create the first subscription plan to start placing operators on it.

new.description: The plan code is permanent once saved — everything else can be changed later.

detail.description: {count, plural, =0 {No operator is on this plan.} one {# operator is on this plan.} other {# operators are on this plan.}}

meta.heading: Plan details
meta.name: Plan name
meta.codeImmutable: The code is permanent and cannot be changed after the plan is created.

info.code: Stable, machine-readable identifier used by billing and by the platform's own default-plan lookup. Lowercase letters, digits, dashes and underscores only. It cannot be changed after creation.
info.name: Name shown to administrators and, for public plans, to operators choosing a plan.
info.description: Short summary of what the plan includes. Optional — leave empty to show nothing.
info.price: Recurring amount charged per billing interval, entered in whole currency units (e.g. 49.90).
info.currency: ISO 4217 code the price is charged in, e.g. EUR. Three uppercase letters.
info.interval: How often the price recurs. Changing it does not re-price existing subscribers on its own.

entitlements.heading: Entitlements
entitlements.hint: What the plan grants. Leave a limit at a number to cap it, or tick Unlimited to remove the cap entirely — 0 is a real limit that permits nothing.

info.maxFacilities: How many facilities the operator may have at once. Creating one past the limit is refused until they upgrade or remove one.
info.maxTariffPlans: How many tariff plans the operator may keep at once, counted across all their facilities.
info.maxStaffSeats: How many team members the operator may have, counting pending invites.
info.commissionBps: The platform's take on each booking, as a percentage of the stay total. Stored as basis points; enter it as a percentage, e.g. 2.50.
info.features: Capabilities the plan unlocks. Each one gates a real surface — an unticked feature is refused, not merely hidden.

info.isPublic: Public plans are offered to operators. A private plan still works exactly the same once assigned by an administrator — it is simply not advertised.
info.sortOrder: Position in the catalog, lowest first. Plans with the same sort order fall back to their code.

archive.title: Archive {name}
archive.body: An archived plan disappears from the catalog and can no longer be assigned. Operators already on it are unaffected.
archive.subscribers: {count, plural, one {# operator is currently on this plan and archiving will be refused.} other {# operators are currently on this plan and archiving will be refused.}}
archive.reasonPlaceholder: Why is this plan being retired?
archive.reasonTooShort: Give at least 3 characters, or leave the reason empty.

sources.subscriptionOverride: The assigned plan, with a negotiated override

info.source: Where the limits in force come from: an exemption, the assigned plan, that plan adjusted by a negotiated override, or the platform's default plan when there is no subscription.

assign.heading: Assign a plan
assign.description: Moving an operator to a smaller plan is refused if they already hold more than it allows — the refusal names exactly what is over the limit.

override.heading: Negotiated override
override.description: Tick only the terms that deviate from the plan; everything left unticked keeps following the catalog. Unticking all of them removes the override entirely.

list.title: Driver plans
list.description: Manage rider subscription plans, pricing and the perks each one grants.

empty.title: No driver plans yet
empty.default: Create your first rider plan to start selling perks.

new.description: The plan code is permanent once saved — everything else can be changed later.

detail.description: {count, plural, one {# live subscriber.} other {# live subscribers.}}
detail.archivedNotice: This plan is archived. It stays readable for history, but no new rider can be assigned to it.

info.code: Permanent machine identifier for this plan, used in audit entries and payment-provider metadata. Lowercase letters, digits, - and _ only. It cannot be changed after the plan is created.
info.codeImmutable: Set when the plan was created and permanent — audit entries and payment-provider records already reference it.
info.name: Name riders see when they compare plans.
info.description: Short summary of what the plan gives a rider. Shown alongside the name wherever plans are listed.
info.price: Amount charged each billing interval, entered in euros. Stored as integer cents, so 9.90 is billed as €9.90 exactly.
info.currency: ISO 4217 code, three uppercase letters (e.g. EUR). Applies to this plan's price.
info.interval: How often the rider is charged. Changing it does not re-price anyone already subscribed.
info.sortOrder: Lower numbers appear first wherever plans are listed. Ties fall back to the plan code.
info.isPublic: Hidden plans stay fully usable and can still be assigned by an administrator — they just never appear in the rider-facing catalog.

entitlements.heading: Perks
entitlements.hint: What a rider on this plan gets. Every field here is what the booking flow reads at price time.

info.bookingDiscount: Percentage taken off the booking price for this rider. Tick “No discount” for a plan that sells other perks but not a price cut.
info.bookingFeeWaived: Drops the platform booking fee entirely for riders on this plan.
info.freeCancellations: How many cancellations a rider may make without a fee per billing period. Tick “Unlimited” for no cap at all — zero and unlimited are opposite answers, so pick deliberately.
info.features: Non-numeric perks this plan unlocks. Each one is checked by name in the code that grants it.

archive.title: Archive driver plan
archive.body: Archiving “{name}” removes it from the catalog. Existing history is kept and nothing is deleted, but no rider can be assigned to it afterwards.
archive.subscribers: {count, plural, one {# rider is subscribed and archiving will be refused until they are moved.} other {# riders are subscribed and archiving will be refused until they are moved.}}

archive.reasonTooShort: Give at least 3 characters, or leave the reason empty.

assign.noPlans: No active driver plan exists yet. Create one before assigning.

override.heading: Negotiated override
override.hint: Only the perks you tick are overridden — everything left unticked keeps following the plan, including later catalog changes.
override.needsPlan: An override amends a plan. Assign this rider a plan first.
